style: Realistic film footage on 35mm, natural light, shallow depth of field, gentle handheld camera, soft grain, warm nostalgic colour. A small remote rocky island in the North Atlantic with a white lighthouse and a keeper's cottage. The father is never seen in the face: only his hands, forearms in a grey knitted fisherman's sweater, his back, or a silhouette.

memories.scene: Night, a small bedroom in the keeper's cottage lit by a bedside lamp. Point of view of a four-year-old girl lying in bed looking up: a man's large hand pulls a patchwork blanket up to her chin; an old storybook rests on the quilt; lighthouse light sweeps faintly across the ceiling.

Night. A small girl of four with a blonde ponytail kneels on a window seat, seen from behind, looking out of a cottage window at the sea glittering under a sky full of stars; a shooting star falls; the lighthouse beam passes.

Dusk, ankle-deep shallows on a sandy cove. Close point of view of a four-year-old girl's small hands scooping at sparkling water, the glints slipping through her fingers; a man's large hand reaches in beside hers.

Golden evening, calm water close to the island's shore. Point of view of a five-year-old girl at the oars of a small wooden rowing boat, the oars far too big for her, splashing; the lighthouse not far behind; a man's knees and hands resting in the stern, not helping.

Close-up, warm afternoon light. A small child's hand, guided by a man's large weathered hand, scratches letters into the wooden seat of a rowing boat with a pocket knife, beside older carved initials; wood shavings.

Summer, a meadow of tall grass and wildflowers on the island's high ground. Low point of view of a five-year-old girl walking through grass taller than her, holding a man's big hand above her; the lighthouse on the skyline.
Cold blue evening on the shore. Close-up of a small girl's warm hands wrapping around a man's large cold weathered hand and rubbing it, her breath misting.
Low tide, a rock pool. A five-year-old girl's small hand holds up a shiny pink shell toward a man's open palm, her point of view, sunlight sparkling on the wet shell.

Sunny grassy clifftop by the lighthouse. Point of view of a laughing five-year-old girl being spun around by her arms, the sky, the white lighthouse and the sea wheeling past; a man's hands holding her wrists.

Clear night on a grassy hill. Point of view of a five-year-old girl lying on her back on a blanket looking up at a sky crowded with stars and the Milky Way; a man's arm beside her points up at one bright star.

Golden evening beside a huge old twisted tree on the island. A five-year-old girl stands on tiptoe reaching up to the lowest branch, seen from behind and a little below, a man's hand steadying her back.
A kitchen table by a window, soft daylight. Close-up of a sheet of paper with a large hand outline traced in crayon and a small hand outline traced inside it; a small hand finishing the drawing.
Windy grey day, a narrow rocky causeway to the island with waves washing over the stones. Point of view of a small girl holding tight to a man's big hand as they step across slippery rocks.

Night, a child's bedroom in the keeper's cottage. Point of view of a nine-year-old girl in bed watching a man's hand turn an oil lamp on the bedside table down to a small glow, not out; the door left open a crack.

Night, the cottage's dark back garden. A nine-year-old girl holding a man's hand peers into deep darkness beyond the reach of a lantern held low; wind in the grass; the lighthouse beam crossing overhead.

Night inside the lighthouse lamp room. A nine-year-old girl with her hands on the glass watches the great beam sweep out across black sea toward faint lights on a distant mainland; a man's silhouette tending the lamp behind her.

Night on the path up to the lighthouse. Point of view of a nine-year-old girl carrying a glowing oil lantern very carefully in both hands, step by step on the stone path, a man's boots walking slowly beside her.
Night, a warm lantern hanging by the cottage door with moths circling it. A nine-year-old girl watches them, seen from behind, the dark sea beyond.
Twilight in a ring of wild mushrooms in the grass. A ten-year-old girl stands in the middle of the ring with her eyes shut, making a wish, seen from a little way off, the lighthouse lit on the hill.
Night. Point of view of a ten-year-old girl in pyjamas, torch in hand, peering down the dark spiral stairs of the lighthouse; the torch beam shaking slightly on the stone steps.
Night in the lamp room. Close-up of a ten-year-old girl's hands turning the brass winding handle of the lighthouse lamp mechanism, a man's hands guiding hers; brass gears and the great lens glowing.

Calm grey evening at sea in a small wooden rowing boat. Point of view of a twelve-year-old girl watching the long dark back of a whale surface and slide under not far away, spray hanging in the air; a man's hands resting on the oars.
Night in the cottage kitchen. A twelve-year-old girl sits at the table with headphones made from an old radio, eyes closed, listening; a book about whales open in front of her; lamp light.
Clear night on the lighthouse gallery. A thirteen-year-old girl leans on the rail looking across black sea at the glow of a distant city on the horizon, seen from behind.

Morning at the island's small harbour. A fourteen-year-old girl walks away down the stone jetty ahead of the camera, turning her head to say something back over her shoulder, a little annoyed; a man's hand lowers from where it had reached for her.
Bright windy day on the high rocks of the island. A fourteen-year-old girl stands at the edge with her arms spread, hair blowing, looking out at endless open ocean, seen from behind.
Overcast day on a pebble beach. A thirteen-year-old girl kneels beside the bleached rib bones of a long-dead whale half buried in the stones, touching one gently, seen from beside her.

Dusk on the cottage step. Point of view of a fourteen-year-old girl looking at a man sitting on the step with his back to her, staring out at the sea; only his shoulders and the back of his head in a knitted hat.
Daylight at the kitchen door. A fifteen-year-old girl in a rain jacket pulls her arm free and walks out alone into the wind, seen from inside; a man's hand on the door frame.

Morning in the cottage kitchen. Close-up of a seventeen-year-old girl's hands holding an opened acceptance letter from a mainland college, trembling a little, sunlight across the table; a man's hand on the table nearby.
Evening on the lighthouse gallery. A seventeen-year-old girl turns from the rail toward a man standing in the lamp-room doorway, seen only as a dark silhouette against the lamp.
Night in the lamp room. Point of view of a seventeen-year-old girl watching a man's hands write the night's entry in a thick lighthouse logbook by lamp light, neat columns of entries.
Late afternoon at a small old bell hung on a post by the island's landing. A seventeen-year-old girl reaches up and rings it once, the bell swinging, the sea behind; seen from just behind her.

Evening at the island's landing. Bags are loaded into a small wooden rowing boat by a man's hands; a seventeen-year-old girl in a coat stands holding a small bundle of envelopes and stamps, the lighthouse behind.

Dusk at sea in the rowing boat. Point of view of a seventeen-year-old girl looking back over the stern at the island and its lighthouse growing small across the water, a distant bell ringing faintly on the wind.

Night at sea in a small wooden rowing boat. Point of view of a seventeen-year-old girl in the stern: a man in a dark oilskin coat rows, seen only from the shoulders down; behind him a vast black wall of storm cloud is swallowing the stars across the whole horizon, lightning flickering inside it, the swell rising.

Night, a violent storm at sea, rain and spray. Point of view of a seventeen-year-old girl clinging to the side of a small swamped tender; a man's hand on the edge of the tender pushes it away from him into the dark waves; lightning lights the churning water for an instant.
